classification.difficultyReason: Select preliminary cosine-rule or sine-rule calculations where necessary before applying the triangle area rule.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of each triangle, correct to the nearest square centimetre.

spec.description: Unshaded scalene triangle with the 10 cm side at left, 12 cm side above and 18 cm side below. Decorative blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: Three side lengths are 10 cm, 12 cm and 18 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied lengths remain visible; no calculated angles or area are shown.

answer.short:
$57\text{ cm}^2$

Find an included angle using the cosine rule, then apply the area rule.
answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle between the 10 cm and 12 cm sides. By the cosine rule:
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{10^2+12^2-18^2}{2\times10\times12}\\\cos\theta&=-\frac13\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\!\left(-\frac13\right)\end{align*}$$
Using the unrounded angle:
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\times10\times12\times\sin\!\left(\cos^{-1}\!\left(-\frac13\right)\right)\\A&=40\sqrt2\text{ cm}^2\\A&\approx57\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with upper-left apex and lower-right included angle labelled 52 degrees; no angle arc is printed in the source. Decorative blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: The 11 cm and 7 cm sides meet at the given 52-degree angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied sides and included angle are visible.

spec.description: Triangle with 18 cm left side joining the 72-degree upper-left vertex and 64-degree lower vertex; third vertex at upper right. Decorative blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: The known side lies between the two given angles, not opposite either given angle.
spec.answerVisibility: No third angle, calculated side or area appears in the question diagram.

answer.short:
$199\text{ cm}^2$

Find the third angle, use the sine rule for another side, then apply the area rule.
answer.worked:
The third angle is $\theta$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-72^\circ-64^\circ\\\theta&=44^\circ\end{align*}$$
Let $x$ cm be the side opposite $64^\circ$. By the sine rule:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{\sin64^\circ}&=\frac{18}{\sin44^\circ}\\x&=\frac{18\sin64^\circ}{\sin44^\circ}\end{align*}$$
The included angle between this side and the 18 cm side is $72^\circ$:
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\times18\times\frac{18\sin64^\circ}{\sin44^\circ}\times\sin72^\circ\\A&\approx199\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
